title: Encounter
description: encounters/<id>.json (spec §4.8). Documentation only: the C# loader (Tactics.Logic PackLoader and Validation) is the authority and also checks meaning (spec §4.10).

level.description: The intended party level (1..10) for balance checks.
Overrides the monster's level (only the sheet's Level changes; the stat block isn't rescaled).

variant.description: A sprite recolour: the monster's sprite key with this as its third part (beasts.wolf.dire).

tag.description: What objectives and triggers call it; defaults to the monster id.

id.description: Names this one unit in the battle (count must be 1). Without it units are numbered "<monster>.<n>" in placement order.

countByParty.description: Explicit positive values for every supported party size; count remains the maximum placement capacity.

hpByParty.description: Explicit positive values for every supported party size; count remains the maximum placement capacity.

unitByParty.description: Explicit monster profile for every supported party size; placement identity and trigger tag remain stable.

items.description: Placed with either at or zone.

when.description: Every key present must hold: round, unitEntersZone{tag, zone, count = 1}, hpBelow{tag, percent}, unitDies{tag}, flag, counter{name, atLeast}, objective{name: an objective leaf, state: met | unmet}, all[...], any[...]. Tags are unit tags, or "party" / "enemy".

items.description: Exactly one of: say{speaker, line}, spawn{unit, at (zone or [x, y]), count, tag, level, aiProfile, ally}, setFlag: name, addCounter{name, amount = 1}, setObjective{win?, lose?}, cameraHint: zone or [x, y], endBattle: Won | Lost | Fled, phase{tag, number} (the phases of the one monster with that tag; a trigger watching hpBelow on it uses the phase's percentage), or effects[...] with exactly one of tag, zone or at (and an optional source tag).

environment.description: Opt this encounter into the loaded environmental reactions; absent is off.

itemLoot.description: Fixed item stacks awarded once to the party on victory, in addition to the existing loot table ids.

retreat.description: Whether the party may vote to fall back (from round 3), ending the battle as a flight. false disables it for a scripted fight; absent is true.

storyOnly.description: Only offered by its regional story. Omitted from the standalone encounter picker; defaults false.
